name: shuming-recent-papers-eval
split_policy: draft_unsplit; freeze grouped splits after contamination and relevance audit

provenance.revision: 20 correlated query variants and 10 synthetic Agent tasks; original corpus and evidence unchanged

relevance_review.method: all-page lexical screening, document profiles, and semantic candidate adjudication
relevance_review.truth_guarantee: assistant silver judgments under the declared answer-support rubric, not independently adjudicated gold

query_variants.split_rule: keep derived query with parent and paper family
query_variants.review: semantic equivalence against existing question, answer and evidence; no independent PDF re-review
